name: Ecolab
description: Ecolab sells cleaning, sanitizing, water-treatment and pest-control programs to businesses, and delivers them through its own field sales and service staff, more than 25,000 of its roughly 48,000 employees. Customers are factories, food and beverage plants, hotels, restaurants, hospitals, data centers and refineries; they buy chemicals plus dispensing and monitoring equipment, often installed and serviced by Ecolab, and reorder as they use them. Its 3D TRASAR technology combines chemistry with remote monitoring of customers' cooling-water systems. FY2025 net sales were $16,081.2M, split roughly half Global Water (industrial water and process treatment) and 38% Institutional & Specialty (cleaners, warewashing, infection prevention); pest elimination and life sciences are the two small, faster-growing lines. It operates directly in about 100 countries outside the US. No single customer or distributor is 10% of revenue.

EDGAR SIC 2840 (Soap, Detergents, Cleaning Preparations). The chemicals box hides a field-service model: more than 25,000 of its 48,000 employees are sales and service staff who visit customer sites, and Pest Elimination is a pure service line.

hq.note: EDGAR business address and Wikipedia S&P 500 list both Saint Paul, MN

employees.note: About 48,000, of whom more than 25,000 are sales and service employees and about 3,000 research, development, engineering and digital experts (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Global Water
businessLines.how: Industrial and food plants buy treatment chemicals and programs on repeat as they run their systems, and Ecolab installs dispensing, monitoring and control equipment (3D TRASAR); the majority of revenue is product and equipment sold, recognised when delivered, with services and leased equipment a smaller part.
businessLines.description: Light & Heavy (cooling, boiler, ultra-pure and process water, wastewater, refining and fuels additives; data centers and microelectronics), Food & Beverage (cleaners, sanitizers, lubricants, water solutions, animal health for dairy, meat, poultry, brewing and bottling plants) and Paper (process applications for pulp and paper). Renamed from Global Industrial on 2025-01-01.

operatingProfit.note: Operating income at public currency; FY2024 $1,274.2M on $7,775.9M. Share is of the four segments' $3,097.7M (sum computed) before corporate items. Organic sales +2%.

businessLines.name: Global Institutional & Specialty
businessLines.how: Restaurants, hotels, hospitals and food retailers buy detergents, sanitizers and dispensers under contracts negotiated by corporate account staff with multi-unit chain customers and serviced by field reps, and reorder as consumables are used; warewashing products alone were about 13% of consolidated net sales in 2025.
businessLines.description: Institutional (warewashing, laundry, infection prevention and food-safety products for hospitality and healthcare) and Specialty (cleaners and sanitizers for quick-service restaurant chains and food retailers, under the Ecolab and Kay brands). Absorbed the former healthcare operating segment in 2025.

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 $1,227.4M on $6,103.4M sales; organic sales +3%. Segment sales at fixed currency were $5,962.0M.

businessLines.name: Global Pest Elimination
businessLines.how: Customers pay Ecolab for pest detection, prevention and elimination services delivered at their sites, so revenue is service work rather than product.
businessLines.description: Service contracts to detect, prevent and eliminate rodents and insects in restaurants, food and beverage processors, hotels, grocery operations, education, life sciences and healthcare facilities.

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 $214.3M on $1,162.8M sales. The 10-K says organic sales growth was strong.

businessLines.name: Global Life Sciences
businessLines.how: Drug and personal-care manufacturers buy end-to-end cleaning and contamination-control solutions and programs, including tailored delivery of key inputs (10-K).
businessLines.description: Cleaning and contamination-control solutions for pharmaceutical and personal-care manufacturers (a standalone segment from 2025).

brands.name: Ecolab, Nalco, 3D TRASAR technology
brands.share: Brand-level sales not disclosed; Nalco and 3D TRASAR are named in the 10-K

brands.name: Kay
brands.share: Brand named in the 10-K for quick-service restaurant cleaning products; sales not disclosed
